title.zh: 一条真实的双 μ 子质量谱

description.zh: 来自 CMS 2010 Run2010B 公共 Mu 数据的 100,000 个双 μ 子事件；每个桶宽 1 GeV/c²。
description.en: 100,000 dimuon events from CMS 2010 Run2010B public Mu data, in 1 GeV/c² bins.

boundary.zh: 这是经过双 μ 子和 2–110 GeV/c² 质量条件筛选的教育衍生数据，不是无偏样本，也不适合完整物理分析；谱峰只能作为候选共振的可视线索，不能单独证明发现。
boundary.en: This is an education-derived sample selected for two muons and 2–110 GeV/c² mass, not an unbiased sample and not suitable for a full physics analysis; peaks are visual clues for candidate resonances, not discovery proof by themselves.

sourceTitle: CERN Open Data record 700 — Dimuon event information derived from the Run2010B public Mu dataset

provenance.selection: CERN record 700: precisely two muons, invariant mass 2–110 GeV, at least one high-quality global muon; source CSV M column used.
provenance.units: M is in GeV/c²; bins are [2+i, 3+i) GeV/c² for i=0..107.
provenance.sourceFile: MuRun2010B.csv (100,000 data rows; downloaded once for offline aggregation)
